articles.title: Justice of the Peace Gregory Johnson to kick off re-election campaign in downtown Killeen
articles.excerpt: A Democrat, he was first elected to the bench in 2020 after serving two terms on the Killeen City Council (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Judge Johnson wins re-election in JP race
articles.excerpt: 2024 election: Johnson won re-election on Nov. 5, 2024 over Republican Jonathan Okray, a former Killeen councilman; with about 91% of votes reported, Johnson had 28,884 votes (57.5%) to Okray's 21,311 (42.5%) (KDH).
